mines.mine_notes: Nickel-zinc-lead polymetallic exploration project, Poland's established mining corridor (Szklary nickel deposit + Dabrowka zinc-lead deposit), held via Ferrite Resources Polska sp. z o.o. Future Mineral acquired an initial 48% interest in June 2025; Feb 2, 2026 agreement to acquire the remaining 52% (from Forbes EV Metals Inc.) to consolidate 100% ownership (transaction pending). Exploration-stage; no production, no revenue.

notes: Base-metals (nickel-zinc-lead) explorer; no gold or silver production or reserves disclosed in FY2025. TSX:FMR. $4.5M financing amended in connection with the Feb 2026 acquisition. No mineral reserves or NI 43-101 resource figures disclosed. All figures in CAD unless noted.
report_title: Future Mineral Delivers Potentially Transformational Transaction with Agreement to Acquire 100% Ownership of High-Grade Nickel-Zinc-Lead Project in Poland (news release, February 2, 2026)
